explain: A deterministic router sends a known task to the correct bounded service. Tool-first execution avoids a model making decisions that code can establish exactly.
steps: Classify an explicit intent enum. || Dispatch through a declared service map rather than arbitrary generated function names.
name: router-pattern

explain: A supervisor gives bounded independent subtasks to specialists and combines typed outputs. The fixture demonstrates task/result contracts, not autonomous delegation.
steps: Define one task per specialist. || Aggregate their results without granting workers the parent's entire authority.
name: supervisor-workers

explain: Delegation returns a subtask result to the caller, whereas handoff changes who owns the active interaction. Ownership must be explicit to prevent simultaneous conflicting responses.
steps: Keep parent ownership during a delegated read. || Change the interaction owner only on a recorded handoff transition.
name: handoff-delegation
